# Code Anchors: Teaching Plan

- `libs/portable-tools/src/workbook-plan.ts` — the plan of slices: parsing, the required repository and epic, the suite, grading and control commands, and which slices are still stubs.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/workbook-plan.spec.ts` — pins the required fields, the handoff slice that names no lesson, and the stub list.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/teaching-plan.ts` — the slice shape the session compares against, including the state each story was pinned to.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/workbook-store.ts` — reads the plan out of the workbook and tells a plan of slices from a plain list of lessons.
